Open models from Hugging Face's inference providers through one router: chat, embeddings, images, speech.

## API key

- **Get your key here:** [huggingface.co](https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens/new?ownUserPermissions=inference.serverless.write&tokenType=fineGrained)
- **Setting:** `HUGGINGFACE_API_TOKEN`
- **API reference:** [huggingface.co](https://huggingface.co/docs/inference-providers/index)

### Get the key

1. Sign in to Hugging Face Inference and open [huggingface.co](https://huggingface.co/settings/tokens/new?ownUserPermissions=inference.serverless.write&tokenType=fineGrained).
2. Create an API key (or token) with only the access your apps need.
3. Copy it. Many providers show a key only once.

**What to create:** A fine-grained access token from Hugging Face settings with the Inference Providers permission; the Gateway sends it as a bearer token. Apps POST OpenAI-style chat to /v1/chat/completions, or other tasks under /&lt;provider>/, such as /hf-inference/models/&lt;model>.

Steps for this provider are brief. [Open an issue](https://github.com/every-app/every-app/issues/new?template=provider-request.yml&title=Provider%20guide%3A%20Hugging%20Face%20Inference) to request a full guide.

### Set it on your Gateway

From your EveryApp folder:

```bash
pnpm everyapp secret set HUGGINGFACE_API_TOKEN
```

It asks for the value at a hidden prompt, and it's live at once, with no deploy. If an app you've installed needs it, `pnpm everyapp configure <app>` asks for it along with everything else the app needs.

### Use it in an app

List it in the app's `everyapp.config.ts`:

```ts
capabilities: {
  huggingface: { access: "read", why: "What the app does with it." },
},
```

`access` is `"read"`. The app calls the provider's own URLs with `integrationFetch()`, and the Gateway adds the key. More in [API providers](/docs/agent/providers).

### Check it worked

- `pnpm everyapp provider show huggingface` shows the key as set and which apps use it.
- `pnpm everyapp status` shows apps that were waiting for it as ready.

### Cost and limits

- **Cost:** Pay as you go at each provider's own rate with no markup; PRO accounts get $2 of compute credits a month.
